display.purpose: The landing headline and a group's headline balance figure only.

title.purpose: Section headings within a page, and modal titles.

label.purpose: Buttons, form labels, nav items, in-app UI chrome.

motion.name: sheet-in
motion.purpose: Modal panel entrance, paired with veil-in.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The default action on every screen — get started, sign in, add expense, save.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: var(--color-primary, #ea580c); color: #fff; border: none; border-radius: var(--radius-control, 8px); padding: 10px 16px; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; transition: background-color 150ms; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-primary-hover, #c2410c); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary, #ea580c); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The paired lesser action beside a primary button.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: var(--color-surface, #fff); color: var(--color-ink, #1c1917); border: 1px solid var(--color-line, #e8e4de); border-radius: var(--radius-control, 8px); padding: 10px 16px; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; transition: background-color 150ms; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--color-canvas, #f8f7f4); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary, #ea580c); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Reserved for the one destructive confirmation: delete.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: var(--color-danger, #dc2626); color: #fff; border: none; border-radius: var(--radius-control, 8px); padding: 10px 16px; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; transition: background-color 150ms; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: var(--color-danger-hover, #b91c1c); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-danger, #dc2626); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: The one container surface in the app — group cards, expense rows' wrapper, the landing product demo panel.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--color-surface, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--color-line, #e8e4de); border-radius: var(--radius-card, 12px); padding: 20px; }

components.name: Input
components.description: Text field used across every form (auth, add-expense, create-group).
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; background: var(--color-surface, #fff); color: var(--color-ink, #1c1917); border: 1px solid var(--color-line, #e8e4de); border-radius: var(--radius-control, 8px); padding: 10px 14px; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; transition: border-color 150ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--color-ink-muted, #a8a29e); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--color-primary, #ea580c); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(234, 88, 12, 0.12); }

components.name: Category Tag
components.description: One neutral tone for every expense category — no per-category color coding, ever.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: var(--color-flat-bg, #f5f5f4); color: var(--color-flat-fg, #57534e); border-radius: 9999px; padding: 2px 8px; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: A group member's status: only two states exist, active and pending.
components.css: .ds-status-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 2px 8px; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-status-badge--active { background: var(--color-pos-bg, #ecfdf5); color: var(--color-pos-fg, #065f46); } .ds-status-badge--pending { background: var(--color-warn-bg, #fffbeb); color: var(--color-warn-fg, #92400e); }

components.name: Balance Pill
components.description: The pill's color IS the balance — settled, owed-to-you, or you-owe — with no separate icon restating it.
components.css: .ds-balance-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 4px 12px; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-balance-pill b { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-balance-pill--credit { background: var(--color-pos-bg, #ecfdf5); color: var(--color-pos-fg, #065f46); } .ds-balance-pill--debit { background: var(--color-neg-bg, #fef2f2); color: var(--color-neg-fg, #991b1b); } .ds-balance-pill--settled { background: var(--color-flat-bg, #f5f5f4); color: var(--color-flat-fg, #57534e); }

components.name: Avatar
components.description: Initials only, one neutral treatment for every person — no per-user color coding.
components.css: .ds-avatar { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-stone-100, #f5f5f4); color: var(--color-stone-600, #57534e); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Modal Sheet
components.description: The dialog shell: a bottom sheet under 640px, a centered card at sm: and up, always over a fading veil.
components.html:
Delete this expense?

This can't be undone.
components.css: .ds-modal-veil { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); padding: 24px; border-radius: 12px; } .ds-modal-sheet { width: 100%; max-width: 380px; background: var(--color-surface, #fff); border-radius: var(--radius-modal, 16px); padding: 24px; } .ds-modal-title { font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-ink, #1c1917); margin: 0; } .ds-modal-body { font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; margin: 6px 0 0; font-size: 14px; color: var(--color-ink-soft, #78716c); } .ds-modal-actions { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 8px; margin-top: 24px; }

narrative.overview:
Splitmate looks like the running tab a group of friends keeps between themselves — plain, warm, and legible, never a finance product performing trustworthiness at you. One confident orange carries every interactive moment (the mascot, the buttons, a focused field, an active link); every other surface stays warm-neutral paper and ink so that orange never has to compete for attention. The system is deliberately flat: no shadow, glow, or gradient anywhere — separation comes from a single hairline border and the contrast between the warm page canvas and white cards, the way a receipt sits on a table rather than floating above it.

Type is a single sans face (Inter) at six fixed sizes and nothing else; components are soft and approachable — generously rounded, generously padded — but restrained, never playful or bouncy. Money is the one thing that gets a structural guarantee: every figure renders in tabular numerals so a column of amounts always lines up, and its color is never decorative, only ever reporting whether a balance is owed, owed-to-you, or settled. Motion is used exactly twice — a modal veil fades in, its sheet rises and settles — and respects reduced-motion; nothing else in the app animates.
keyCharacteristics: One accent color, reserved entirely for interaction and state — never decoration.
Flat by construction: depth is a border and a background shift, not a shadow.
A six-step type scale, one typeface, no display face.
Money always tabular, always colored by what it means, never by taste.
Soft, rounded, generously-padded components; nothing sharp or clinical.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Ember Orange appears only on buttons, links, a focused input, and active state. If something on screen is orange, it is either asking to be clicked or telling you it already was.

rules.name: The Signal, Not Style Rule
rules.body: Every non-neutral color besides Ember Orange exists to report a fact (owed / owes / pending / destructive) — never to decorate a card, a heading, or an icon.

rules.name: The Six-Step Rule
rules.body: The entire app draws from six font sizes (12/14/16/18/24/30px) and no others. A seventh size is never introduced for a one-off heading.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: No component ever gains a box-shadow. If something needs to look "raised," give it a border and a lighter background instead.

dos: Do reserve Ember Orange for buttons, links, a focused input, and active state — nowhere else.
Do render every money figure with tabular numerals (the .num utility) and one of the four financial-state colors.
Do build new surfaces from the three-step radius scale (8/12/16px) plus full pills — never an arbitrary corner radius.
Do convey elevation with a border and a background shift, never a shadow.
donts: Don't add a box-shadow, glow, or gradient anywhere in the app.
Don't invent a per-category or per-user color — categories and avatars share one neutral (Ash/Slate Stone) tone by design.
Don't introduce a type size outside the six-step scale (12/14/16/18/24/30px).
Don't use Signal Red (or its hover) outside a destructive-confirmation flow — it is not a general-purpose "error" color; form errors use Deep Brick/Blush instead.
